maudhui: (1) Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 46, the National Assembly may pass a resolution to remove the President from office where a motion to impeach the President is moved and passed in accordance with this Article. (2) A motion to impeach the President shall not be moved except where it is alleged that the President - (a) has committed acts which generally violate the Constitution or the law concerning the ethics of public leaders; (b) has committed acts which contravene the ethics concerning the registration of political parties; or (c) has conducted himself in a manner that lowers the esteem of the office of President of the United Republic; and no such motion shall be moved within twelve months from the date on which a similar motion was moved and rejected by the National Assembly. (3) The National Assembly shall not pass a motion to impeach the President unless - (a) a written notice signed and supported by not less than twenty percent of all Members of Parliament is submitted to the Speaker at least thirty days before the sitting; and (b) the Speaker permits the mover to present the motion. (4) A Special Committee of Inquiry shall consist of the Chief Justice of the United Republic as Chairman, the Chief Justice of Tanzania Zanzibar and seven members appointed by the Speaker. (5) Where the National Assembly passes a motion to establish a Special Committee of Inquiry, the President shall be deemed to be absent from office. (6) Within seven days after the Committee is constituted, it shall sit, investigate and analyse the charges against the President. (7) As soon as possible, the Committee shall submit its report to the Speaker. (8) After the Speaker receives the report, it shall be submitted to the National Assembly. (9) The National Assembly shall debate the report and may pass a resolution supported by not less than two-thirds of all Members of Parliament. (10) Where the National Assembly passes a resolution that the charges have been proved, the Speaker shall inform the President and the President shall be required to resign before the expiry of the third day. (11) Where the President ceases to hold office under this Article, he shall not be entitled to any pension benefits.
